reading: A renovation schedule for an occupied house, seven rows on one time axis: survey; plan and choose materials; approval, alongside the planning; the trades trained first; the main supply; the rooms one after the other (read only, then actions that can be undone, then changes fraud could use); running it, from the first room on. A band along the bottom: the people stay at home throughout. An open diamond after each piece of work: inspected at every step.
headline: Renovate in this order, with the people at home, and inspect as you go.
note: Schematic lengths in arbitrary units on one shared axis: the order and the overlaps matter, no duration or date is measured. The everyday words are the analogy; the second line of each row is what the step means for Telekom.

rows.label: Survey
rows.company: one measure for both countries, with its cost
rows.note: Telekom's 2030 targets have no measure that compares with T-Mobile's; the measure is the article's proposal (section 9, point 1)

rows.label: Plan and choose materials
rows.company: keep the switch between model suppliers; data hosted in Germany

rows.label: Approval
rows.company: works agreement and AI Act status settled while planning
rows.note: runs alongside the planning, not after the building

rows.label: Trades first
rows.company: staff trained before the tools arrive, least experienced first
rows.note: the least experienced gain most from the new tools (R4-29)

rows.label: The main supply
rows.company: 14 ways of proving who calls cut to 3; one usable customer record

segments.label: changes fraud could use
segments.note: changing bank details after login already exists (R6-16)

rows.label: Running it
rows.company: a named team answers for it, nights included; cost per request watched
rows.note: starts after the first room and does not end

home.label: People at home throughout
home.company: no dismissals for business reasons until the end of 2028

inspection.label: inspected at every step
inspection.note: an open diamond after each work bar, and along the running: the inspection goes with the work, not after it
